open_points.subject: accept_binding on already accepted binding with stale manifest pin
open_points.text: State 0 (Primary actions): "accepting an accepted binding returns it" and also "an unknown binding, or one whose manifest entry no longer matches its pin, is refused (State 2, A08)"; A08 rule 7: "an `accepted` binding is returned unchanged, without reading the manifest, even when its digest has changed meanwhile".
open_points.question: When the owner calls accept on an already accepted binding whose manifest operation digest no longer matches the pin, must the call be refused or must it return the existing accepted binding unchanged?
options: Refuse when digest no longer matches the pin (State 0 table failure rule).
Return unchanged for any already accepted binding, without manifest read (A08 rule 7).
open_points.default_guess: Follow A08 rule 7 (return unchanged), because it is the later and more explicit rule text.

open_points.subject: A05 phase 9 reachability check for function outputs
open_points.text: A05 rule 1.9: "at least one output of every function node reaches, through edges and nodes, a flow output or an operation node".
open_points.question: Does "reaches" mean purely structural graph reachability ignoring guards, reachability under at least one guard outcome, or guaranteed reachability under all guard outcomes?
options: Structural reachability in the static graph (ignore guard truth values).
Existential semantic reachability (there exists some guard outcome/path).
Universal semantic reachability (must reach for every possible guard outcome).
open_points.default_guess: Use structural reachability ignoring guard outcomes.

open_points.subject: request-check precedence for purpose mismatch vs other request checks
open_points.text: A01 rule 5: "This check comes before every other check of the request." A16 rule 1: requests are handled in fixed order: size, token/config, known operation+schema, actor authorization, then operation-specific checks.
open_points.question: Is purpose consistency (A01) globally the first check for those operations, or only first within operation-specific checks after A16’s envelope checks?
options: Global first check for that request type, ahead of all other checks.
First only within operation-specific checks, after A16 size/token/schema/actor checks.
open_points.default_guess: Apply A16 envelope order first, then apply A01 purpose check first within the operation-specific stage.
